abstract.t: hi, i'm nora 🏳️‍⚧️. this is my website. you'll find lots of interesting and not very interesting stuff here, depending on where you look.

section.t: i have a blog, it might be interesting, maybe.

section.title: Socials
section.t: these two are not everything, but you may find more there, like a choose your own adventure story: choose your own nora

section.title: Slides
section.t: i've given some (one) talks. you can find the slides on my website, right over there. i made them with reveal.js which means you can interact with them right on the web, it's like magic.

section.title: Rust
section.t: I've spent a lot of time working on the Rust Programming Language as part of the compiler and standard library contributors team. My most famous work are the improved cfg diagnostics released in 1.72.0. Other than that, I've contributed countless refactors and improvements to all kinds of areas from the parser to the backend. I've also reviewed hundreds of PRs for both the compiler and standard library, of which only one caused a serious regression that warranted a point release (1.74.1).

section.title: Other
section.t: Most of my projects are only short-lived and not exciting enough to put here. I have written a lot of code that does fun things. You can find it all on my GitHub.

section.title: Contact
section.t: if you want to contact me for something, use any of the following platforms

ul.li: discord (preferred): noratrieb . if you're on a server where i'm too (like the Rust Community Discord) you can just DM me (make sure to include the reason in the first message or i will ignore it)

section.t: if for some reason you really like being super secret then age-encrypt something with my current SSH key found on GitHub.
i do not have a PGP key and do not intend on getting one.
